title: One-Click Hair Release Slicker Brush for Cats and Dogs
bullets: Per the maker, a one-click button releases trapped hair, so you do not need to pull it off by hand.
Rounded tips that the maker says are gentle on skin.
Fine stainless steel bristles that the maker says reach the undercoat to remove loose hair.
Lightweight handle with a non-slip grip and a hanging hole for storage.
Listed as washable with a one-piece design; listed weight of 90 g, in white.
description:
Shedding is a constant job for many dog and cat parents. This slicker brush for cats and dogs has a one-click button that, per the maker, releases hair from the bristles, so you do not need to pull the hair off by hand.

Per the maker's listing, the fine stainless steel bristles reach the undercoat to remove loose hair and tangles, and the rounded tips are meant to be gentle on skin. Per the maker, the handle is lightweight with a non-slip grip, and a hanging hole helps with storage.

The brush is listed as washable with a one-piece design, and its listed weight is about 90 g (3.2 oz). It comes in white. Rinse it and let it air dry after use.

Ships from a US warehouse, and the shipping window is listed in the FAQ below.

faq.q: Do I need to pull the hair off the brush by hand?
faq.a: No. The maker describes a one-click button that releases trapped hair from the bristles.

faq.q: Is it for both cats and dogs?
faq.a: The maker lists it for cats and dogs, with long and short hair.
Estimate: 3–7 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from a US warehouse.
